cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says authentication is used across services or channels; no public body is named using the e-KYC registry.
cells.note: The central bank launched an e-KYC registry in October 2025 for banks, financial institutions and certain public bodies (SWZ-005), after banks began checking the civil registry (SWZ-002, SWZ-003). Banks checking IDs are one service, and no public body is shown using it, so not across services.
